title: The Sawyer family / What does she do in the morning?
subtitle: 索耶一家人 / 她上午做什么？

lead.question: 你能用英语把一家人的日常作息讲清楚吗——谁去上班、谁上学、谁在家做家务、晚上谁看报？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你向朋友介绍「索耶一家」：早上爸爸上班、孩子上学，妈妈在家做家务、正午吃午饭；下午她见朋友、一起喝茶；傍晚孩子放学回家，爸爸下班回家；晚上孩子做作业、爸爸看报。全课用一般现在时讲有规律的习惯动作，动词大多是第三人称单数（goes / stays / does / arrives）。注意几个不带冠词的固定搭配：go to work / go to school / go to bed / stay at home / at noon / at night。第 56 课把 What does she do …? 配各种日常活动反复操练。
goals: 能用一般现在时描述家庭日常作息（习惯动作）
掌握第三人称单数动词变位（goes / stays / does / arrives 等）
记住不带冠词的短语：go to work / go to school / go to bed / stay at home / at noon / at night
能用 What does he/she/they do (at time)? 询问并描述日常活动
lead.summary: 第 55 课以第三人称叙述索耶一家的日常：索耶先生早上上班、孩子上学（父亲每天送他们）；索耶夫人每天在家做家务、正午吃午饭；下午见朋友、一起喝茶；傍晚孩子早睡、先生晚归；夜里孩子做作业后睡觉，先生通常看报、有时和妻子看电视。全课用一般现在时表习惯。第 56 课用 What does she do in the morning? 等问句把整理床铺、刮胡子、听立体声、擦黑板、洗碗、打字、看电视等活动逐一操练。
lead.tips: ① 一般现在时表习惯/规律动作，常配频度副词 usually/always/often/sometimes；② 第三人称单数变位：直接加 -s（comes/arrives）、-sh/-ch/-o/-s 加 -es（washes/goes/watches/does）、辅音+y 变 -ies（carries）；③ go to work/school/bed 与 stay at home 中 work/school/bed/home 前不加冠词；④ at noon/night 用 at，in the morning/afternoon/evening 用 in；⑤ housework 不可数。

questions.q: When do the children do their homework?
questions.zh: 孩子们什么时候做功课？
questions.hint: 听 At night, the children always do their homework.
The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.

questions.q: What does Mrs Sawyer do every day?
questions.a: She stays at home, does the housework, and always eats her lunch at noon.
questions.aZh: 她呆在家里、做家务，总是在正午吃午饭。
questions.hint: stays at home / does the housework / eats her lunch at noon

questions.q: When does Mr Sawyer arrive home, and what does he usually do at night?
questions.zh: 索耶先生什么时候到家？夜里通常做什么？
questions.a: He arrives home late (in the evening). At night he usually reads his newspaper, but sometimes watches television.
questions.aZh: 他傍晚很晚到家；夜里通常看报，有时看电视。
questions.hint: arrives home late / reads his newspaper

questions.q: Why is the simple present tense used throughout this lesson instead of past or future?
questions.zh: 为什么全课用一般现在时，而不是过去时或将来时？
questions.a: The text describes habitual, regular daily routines of the Sawyer family, which is exactly what the simple present is for. Verbs take the third-person singular form (goes, stays, does, arrives) because the subjects are he/she/it/they-the-family.
questions.aZh: 课文描述索耶一家有规律的习惯动作，正是一般现在时的用途；主语为单三，动词加 -s/-es（goes/stays/does/arrives）。
questions.hint: 习惯动作 + 频度副词用一般现在时。

questions.q: What does she do in the morning? She always makes the bed in the morning. / What do they do in the evening? They sometimes listen to the stereo.
questions.zh: 第 56 课操练：What does/do … do (at time)? 配日常活动与频度副词。
questions.a: What does he do every day? He always cleans the blackboard every day.
questions.aZh: 他每天做什么？他每天总是擦黑板。

lines.en: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.

lines.zh: 早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。父亲每天送孩子们去上学。

lines.en: Mrs Sawyer stays at home every day. She does the housework. She always eats her lunch at noon.
lines.zh: 索耶夫人每天呆在家里。她料理家务。她总是在正午吃午饭。

lines.zh: 晚上，孩子们总是做作业，然后去睡觉。索耶先生通常读报纸，但有时和他的妻子一起看电视。

text.title: What does she do in the morning?

drill.q: What does / do ___ do (in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening / at night / every day)?
drill.zh: ……（在上午/下午/晚上/夜里/每天）做什么？（把主语与时间填进横线，配频度副词与活动作答）

slots.zh: 她 — 上午 — 整理床铺
他 — 上午 — 刮胡子

slots.en: he — every day — cleans the blackboard

they — in the afternoon — type some letters

What do they do in the evening? They sometimes listen to the stereo in the evening.

exercises.q: 汉译英：索耶一家住在国王街87号。
exercises.a: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
exercises.note: 姓氏复数 the Sawyers 表全家；live at + 地址。

exercises.q: 第 56 课：What does she do in the morning? — ___ always makes the bed in the morning.
exercises.note: 问 she 答 she；makes 单三。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他们经常在一起喝茶。
exercises.note: often 频度副词；together 一起。

exercises.q: 第 56 课：What do they do at night? — They always ___ (go) to bed early at night.
exercises.note: 主语 they 非单三，用原形 go；go to bed 不加冠词。

exercises.q: 改错：Mrs Sawyer stays at the home every day.
exercises.a: Mrs Sawyer stays at home every day.
exercises.note: stay at home 中 home 前不加 the。

quiz.q: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street. 中的 live 是：
quiz.note: live 作动词，the Sawyers 复数用原形。

quiz.q: go to work / go to school 中 work, school 前：

quiz.note: at night 在夜里；傍晚用 in the evening。

quiz.q: She does the housework. 的否定句是：
quiz.note: 实义动词否定借助 doesn't，后接原形 do。

quiz.q: stay at home 中的 home 是：
quiz.note: 在 stay at home 中 home 是名词，at 为介词；若说 stay home 则 home 为副词。

grammar.title: 一般现在时（2）：习惯动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词原形 / 单三形式（+ 频度副词/时间短语）
grammar.definition: 一般现在时表示习惯动作、有规律的行为以及永恒现象，常与频度副词（always/often/sometimes/usually）和时间短语（every day, in the morning, at noon/night）连用。
grammar.usage: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street. / She always eats her lunch at noon.

examples.en: Mr Sawyer goes to work in the morning.
They often drink tea together.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数动词变位
grammar.definition: 当主语是 he/she/it 时，谓语动词变位：① 直接加 -s（come→comes, arrive→arrives）；② 以 -sh/-ch/-o/-s 结尾加 -es（wash→washes, go→goes, watch→watches, do→does）；③ 辅音+y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 -es（carry→carries），元音+y 只加 -s（play→plays）。
grammar.usage: goes to work / does the housework / arrives home late

examples.en: Mrs Sawyer stays at home every day.
examples.zh: 索耶夫人每天呆在家里。

examples.en: He arrives home late.

grammar.title: 不带冠词的固定搭配（go to … / at …）
grammar.structure: go to work / go to school / go to bed；stay at home；at noon / at night；in the morning/afternoon/evening
grammar.definition: 由 go 引导的短语 work/school/bed 前不带冠词；home 在 stay at home 中作名词也不加 the；具体时刻/正午/夜里用 at（at noon/at night），上/下/晚用 in（in the morning/afternoon/evening）。
grammar.usage: go to work / go to bed / stay at home / eat lunch at noon

examples.en: Mr Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
examples.zh: 索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。

examples.en: She always eats her lunch at noon.

phrases.phrase: go to work / go to school / go to bed
phrases.usage: 上班 / 上学 / 上床睡觉（不加冠词）

examples.zh: 索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。

examples.zh: 索耶夫人每天呆在家里。

examples.en: She does the housework.

phrases.usage: 到家（home 副词前不加 at）

examples.en: They arrive home early.
She always eats her lunch at noon.
